# SkinScan

> Photograph a mole, pin it on a 3D body map, and see what it does over months. AI describes what it sees; an optional real dermatologist can review it. SkinScan records and describes. It never diagnoses.

## Pages
- / — Home and overview
- /login — Sign in
- /legal — Privacy, terms and medical disclaimer

## Not for crawling
- /app, /doctor, /onboarding, /api — private health data behind sign-in
